subject.title: [Refactor] Consolidate synthetic log formats across MCP service pipelines

question: Should standalone MCP adapters have one stable startup-diagnostic format, or should they retain adapter-specific stderr prefixes over the already-shared error normalization?
rationale: Source shows substantial shared infrastructure but no documented or tested cross-adapter log contract, so deciding whether identical diagnostics are a product/support requirement needs owner intent.

options.title: Retain Named Diagnostics
options.body: Keep adapter-specific prefixes and avoid another abstraction until a concrete consumer or consistency failure establishes a shared contract.

options.title: Define Shared Contract
options.body: Specify common diagnostic fields, preserve adapter identity as data, and cover both adapters with focused tests before extracting the helper.

recommendation.title: Retain Named Diagnostics
recommendation.body: Keep adapter-specific prefixes and avoid another abstraction until a concrete consumer or consistency failure establishes a shared contract.

likelyOwner.reason: The clearest available history signal is the merged standalone MCP service infrastructure work and the explicit connection to this issue.
